name: PM-KISAN
benefit: Eligible landholding farmer families receive ₹6,000 per year through Direct Benefit Transfer in three equal installments.
howToApply: Register through the official PM-KISAN portal or through the appropriate government agriculture authorities.
verificationNote: Final eligibility depends on landholding status, government exclusion criteria and verification by the concerned authorities.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
benefit: Eligible women from poor households can receive support for obtaining an LPG connection.
documents: Household / ration card details where applicable
howToApply: Apply through an authorized LPG distributor or the official PMUY process.
verificationNote: The applicant must meet the scheme's household and LPG-connection conditions.

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
benefit: Financial assistance is provided to eligible meritorious students pursuing higher education.
howToApply: Applications are submitted through the National Scholarship Portal when the application window is open.
verificationNote: Fresh applicants must satisfy academic merit, family-income and other scholarship conditions specified by the scheme.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban 2.0
benefit: Eligible urban households can receive housing assistance through applicable PMAY-U 2.0 verticals.
howToApply: Apply through the official PMAY-U 2.0 portal or the relevant urban local authority.
verificationNote: Eligibility also depends on urban residence, house ownership and the specific PMAY-U 2.0 component.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana
benefit: Provides access to basic banking services including a savings account, RuPay debit card and eligible overdraft facilities.
documents: Aadhaar card or accepted identity document
howToApply: Open a basic savings bank deposit account through a participating bank branch or Business Correspondent (Bank Mitra).
verificationNote: PMJDY is intended for persons who do not already have another bank account.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
benefit: Provides renewable accident insurance cover, including ₹2 lakh for accidental death or permanent total disability and ₹1 lakh for specified partial disability.
documents: Bank or post office account details
howToApply: Enroll through a participating bank or post office with the required account and auto-debit consent.
verificationNote: An eligible bank or post office account is required for enrollment.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
benefit: Provides renewable life insurance cover of ₹2 lakh for death due to any reason, subject to scheme terms.
documents: Bank or post office account details
howToApply: Enroll through a participating bank or post office with the required account and auto-debit consent.
verificationNote: A participating bank or post office account is required and the scheme operates subject to its terms and conditions.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
benefit: A government-backed pension scheme for eligible subscribers, with pension options beginning at ₹1,000 per month and going up to ₹5,000 per month at age 60 depending on the selected contribution plan.
documents: Savings bank or post office account details
howToApply: Enroll through a participating bank or post office.
verificationNote: New subscribers who are or have been income-tax payers are not eligible under the current APY rules.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
benefit: Provides crop insurance coverage to eligible farmers for notified crops and notified areas, subject to scheme conditions.
howToApply: Apply through the official PMFBY portal, participating channels or the applicable crop insurance process.
verificationNote: Coverage depends on the notified crop, notified area, insurable interest and applicable enrollment conditions.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
benefit: Provides working-capital support and other incentives to eligible street vendors.
howToApply: Apply through the official PM SVANidhi process or participating lending institutions / urban local bodies.
verificationNote: Final eligibility depends on street-vendor identification and the applicable PM SVANidhi guidelines.

name: PM Vishwakarma
benefit: Provides support to eligible traditional artisans and craftspeople, including recognition, skill training, toolkit support, credit support and marketing assistance.
documents: Identity / registration details required under the scheme
howToApply: Apply through the official PM Vishwakarma registration process, generally with assistance through the designated Common Service Centre process.
verificationNote: The applicant must work in one of the notified traditional trades and satisfy the scheme's other conditions.
